337:     def write_bytes(self, pair, data, expires):
338:         if type(data) is not bytes or not 0 < len(data) <= HEADER.size + MAX_BODY + 32:
339:             raise PipeRefusal("frame_write_bound")
340:         with self._frame_operation(pair):
341:             offset = 0
342:             while offset < len(data):
343:                 offset += self._io(pair, True, data[offset:offset + IO_CHUNK], expires)

345:     def _read_exact(self, pair, size, expires):
346:         if type(size) is not int or not 0 < size <= HEADER.size + MAX_BODY + 32:
347:             raise PipeRefusal("frame_read_bound")
348:         chunks, received = [], 0
349:         while received < size:
350:             data = self._io(pair, False, min(IO_CHUNK, size - received), expires)
351:             received += len(data)
352:             chunks.append(data)
353:         return b"".join(chunks)

355:     def read_frame(self, pair, expires):
356:         with self._frame_operation(pair):
357:             header = self._read_exact(pair, HEADER.size, expires)
358:             _, _, _, length = HEADER.unpack(header)
359:             if not 0 < length <= MAX_BODY:
360:                 self._quarantine(pair)
361:                 raise PipeRefusal("frame_declared_length")
362:             return header + self._read_exact(pair, length + 32, expires)

365:         if pair.role != "worker":

121: @dataclass(frozen=True)
122: class GenerationBinding:
123:     generation_hex: str
124:     manifest_sha256: str
125:     namespace_sha256: str
126:     bootstrap_source_sha256: str
127:     process_creation_time: int
128: 
129:     def encoded(self):
130:         for value in (self.generation_hex, self.manifest_sha256, self.namespace_sha256, self.bootstrap_source_sha256):
131:             _require(_hex(value), "generation_binding_digest")
132:         _require(type(self.process_creation_time) is int and 0 < self.process_creation_time < 1 << 64,
133:                  "process_creation_binding")
134:         return bytes.fromhex(self.generation_hex + self.manifest_sha256 + self.namespace_sha256
135:                              + self.bootstrap_source_sha256) + self.process_creation_time.to_bytes(8, "big")

138: def encode_private_bootstrap(binding, master_key):
139:     # This packet is only for the controller-created, inherited private pipe.
140:     # It must not be logged, placed on a command line, or accepted from a file.
141:     _require(type(binding) is GenerationBinding and type(master_key) is bytes and len(master_key) == 32,
142:              "private_bootstrap_material")
143:     binding.encoded()
144:     return BOOTSTRAP.pack(BOOTSTRAP_MAGIC, master_key, bytes.fromhex(binding.generation_hex),
145:                           bytes.fromhex(binding.manifest_sha256), bytes.fromhex(binding.namespace_sha256),
146:                           bytes.fromhex(binding.bootstrap_source_sha256), binding.process_creation_time)
147: 
148: 
149: def decode_private_bootstrap(packet):
150:     _require(type(packet) is bytes and len(packet) == BOOTSTRAP.size, "private_bootstrap_packet_bound")
151:     magic, key, generation, manifest, namespace, source, creation = BOOTSTRAP.unpack(packet)
152:     _require(magic == BOOTSTRAP_MAGIC, "private_bootstrap_magic")
153:     binding = GenerationBinding(generation.hex(), manifest.hex(), namespace.hex(), source.hex(), creation)
154:     binding.encoded()
155:     return binding, key

158: class GenerationChannel:
159:     """One direction each; private transport/bootstrap remain platform duties.
160: 
161:     master_key is an ephemeral bootstrap secret, never a provider credential or
162:     command-line argument. It must arrive only through the exact inherited
163:     private bootstrap pipe. This class does not authenticate its provenance.
164:     """
165: 
166:     def __init__(self, binding, master_key, role):
167:         _require(type(binding) is GenerationBinding and type(master_key) is bytes and len(master_key) == 32,
168:                  "private_bootstrap_material")
169:         _require(role in ("controller", "worker"), "channel_role")
170:         self.binding = binding
171:         self._context = binding.encoded()
172:         self._send_direction = 0 if role == "controller" else 1
173:         self._receive_direction = 1 - self._send_direction
174:         self._key = hmac.digest(master_key, b"uoink-generation-v1\x00" + self._context, "sha256")
175:         self._send_sequence = 0
176:         self._receive_sequence = 0
177:         self._revoked = False
178:         self._lock = RLock()
179:         self._active = False

483: class ControllerHandshake:
484:     def __init__(self, channel, local_session, local_permit, primitives, native_worker):
485:         _require(type(channel) is GenerationChannel and channel._send_direction == 0, "controller_channel_required")
486:         # These references stay in the controller. Fixed lifecycle code must
487:         # compare the actual record/permit identity and live state at each call.
488:         self._channel, self._session, self._permit = channel, local_session, local_permit
489:         self._primitives, self._worker = primitives, native_worker
490:         self._sent = False
491:         self._ready = False
492:         self._begun = False
493: 
494:     def _owned_phase(self, startup):
495:         with self._session._manager._lock:
496:             record = self._session._record
497:             _require(self._session._manager._records.get(record.key) is record and record.owner is self._session,
498:                      "controller_owner_identity")
499:             _require(record.permit is self._permit and not self._session._revoked and not self._session._closing,
500:                      "controller_permit_identity")
501:             _require(record.phase is (Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED if startup else Phase.NATIVE_RUNNING), "controller_phase")
502:             _require(any(worker is self._worker for worker in self._primitives.workers)
503:                      and self._worker.read_set is record.protection and self._worker.assigned
504:                      and not self._worker.unconfirmed and not self._worker.shutdown_started
505:                      and self._worker.creation_time == self._channel.binding.process_creation_time,
506:                      "owned_process_generation_binding")
507: 
508:     def challenge(self):
509:         self._owned_phase(True)
510:         _require(not self._sent, "challenge_single_use")
511:         self._sent = True
512:         return self._channel.encode("challenge", {"generation": self._channel.binding.generation_hex,
513:                                                    "namespace_sha256": self._channel.binding.namespace_sha256})
514: 
515:     def accept_ready(self, frame):
516:         self._owned_phase(True)
517:         _require(self._sent and not self._ready, "ready_order")
518:         operation, payload = self._channel.decode(frame)
519:         _require(operation == "ready" and payload == {"generation": self._channel.binding.generation_hex,
520:                  "namespace_sha256": self._channel.binding.namespace_sha256}, "worker_ready_binding")
521:         self._owned_phase(True)
522:         self._ready = True
523: 
524:     def begin(self):
525:         self._owned_phase(False)
526:         _require(self._ready and not self._begun, "controller_worker_not_ready_or_already_begun")
527:         frame = self._channel.encode("begin", {"manifest_sha256": self._channel.binding.manifest_sha256})
528:         self._begun = True
529:         return frame
